newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Lombard rate soars to 200.72 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania Lombard rate soars to 200.72 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday the Lombard rate jumped to 200.72 percent from a previous 90 percent following the rise of the average rate on one-week refinancing funds to 125.45 percent from 90 percent.
The Lombard rate, set weekly by multiplying the average auctioned rate by 1.6 starting this week, is charged on overdraft credits.
At Thursday's auction the average rate hit the highest level since mid-1994, after the BNR's refinancing offer was heavily oversubscribed on a cash-hungry money market.
